status: frozen before any new approximate evolution
execution_rule: Run 14q first; extend 16q only if measured resource cost is manageable, never based on observed errors.
target: Exact retained binary64 Pauli Hamiltonian and three chronological schedules frozen in followup_h2o/results design.json; common scalar omitted.
state_sector: Full Nalpha=Nbeta=3 sector; interleaved alpha/beta modes, q0 most significant.
state_selection: Dense scipy.linalg.eigh lowest 16 eigenvectors, increasing selected range if first two clusters not complete; energy-cluster span tolerance 1e-10 Hartree. Select the first coordinate-projector canonical vector of the ground cluster and of the next distinct-energy cluster. Fix phase at the earliest component within 1e-12 of maximal magnitude; twice modified Gram-Schmidt, projection norm >1e-10. Equal coherent is their positive equal superposition. No total-spin assumption.
state_freeze: Save initial_states.npz plus hashes and design before any approximate-state errors.
propagation_space: Full 2^n Hilbert space, preserving all number/spin leakage and any minute off-sector target entries.
reference: Independent sparse assembly from written Pauli letters, scipy expm_multiply on full Hilbert space. Compare with eigenphase prediction and split-time reference; measure rather than ignore full-H off-sector residual.
checks: Independent tensor-axis Pauli actions and sampled products vs QHAT; source hashes; normalized stable overlap E; infidelity; phase-sensitive and aligned norm; particle/spin leakage; S2 expectation/variance; normalized energy drift relative to exact evolved state; eigensolver residuals; HF archived state comparison.
scope: Two related reconstructed active-space models selected for previous HF success. Not independent molecules, not unbiased discovery test, and not a new ordering rule.
